question: Has Chosen Foods been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns Chosen Foods now?
markdown:
Chosen Foods is majority-owned by the Los Angeles-based private equity firm
Butterfly Equity
, which acquired its controlling interest in September 2021. Prior to that, Mexico-based processor Sesajal held the majority stake starting in 2017.
